title: Finite biased Boolean probability
statement: For a real parameter $\rho$, define the probability of a property $A$ of Boolean lists of length $m$ recursively. For $m=0$, it is $1$ if $A$ holds of the empty list and $0$ otherwise. For length $m+1$, it is $\rho$ times the length-$m$ probability of $A$ after prepending true, plus $1-\rho$ times the length-$m$ probability of $A$ after prepending false.
